query:
SELECT 
  id,
  company_name,
  announcement_date,
  target_country_name,
  target_name,
  investment_type,
  deal_size_usd
FROM investments
WHERE (company_name, announcement_date, target_country_name) IN (
  SELECT company_name, announcement_date, target_country_name
  FROM investments
  GROUP BY company_name, announcement_date, target_country_name
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
ORDER BY company_name, announcement_date;
